other_conditions: Entity must be a startup, new industry, or innovation project as defined, proposing to set up an enterprise in the micro or small scale category in the services sector relating to the focus areas.
Incentives cannot be availed on the same component under both State and Central schemes.
benefits_summary: Monthly sustenance allowance of ₹25,000 for one year, up to ₹10 lakh marketing assistance, and patent filing reimbursement up to ₹2 lakh (domestic) or ₹10 lakh (foreign).
